issues.description: The template's addGuestStudents method signature includes an extra boolean parameter (addGuestStudents(int, boolean)) while the problem specification and the solution expect addGuestStudents(int). This discrepancy will confuse students about the correct method to implement and can cause signature mismatches with the reference solution or automated tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template method signature to match the specification and solution: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) { ... } — remove the boolean validateInput parameter (or alternatively, update the problem statement and solution to include and document the boolean if that was intended).
